title: Dear support team
body:
I love the app it’s fun and easy but I have a problem.
I’m new, as in I just downloaded it two days ago new.
But I can’t add new tasks, because when I click on the plus button, all it pops up are ads, that’s it, nothing else. Just ads.
And I would like to have other tasks on as well, not just ones I got recommended by the system at the very start, or ones I got from videos like “stretch!”
Thank you for reading all of this (I know it’s a lot but I can’t express myself without this many words😅), and thank you for understanding my problem and I hope u can help me ☺️
Best regards: Anna

title: I feel so stupid
body:
The sleep tracking on this app is inaccurate to say the least. I left it in an empty room and it had a full sleep cycle report, with periods of light sleep and deep sleep. There was no one there! I did this because the app was telling me that I spent about three hours awake at night, when I knew I was sleeping pretty well. 

I feel so stupid for spending my money on this!
